claimSpecificQualifiers: Procedural impartiality must be implemented and encountered before perceived fairness is assessed.
The route is bounded to the Relationship's population, context, and measurement interval.

implementationRequirement.definition: The specified impartial procedure is realized in practice for the applicable target set.

bindings.eligibilityRule: Formal coverage or eligibility alone is insufficient.
bindings.assignmentRule: Assignment alone is insufficient without the person's actual encounter.

actualExposureRule.definition: The target person actually encounters the implemented procedure.

bindings.exposureWindow: Implementation and actual encounter precede bounded person-level perceived-fairness measurement.
bindings.coverageRule: An exact applicable target set is required; partial coverage is valid only when the evaluated person belongs to that set and was exposed.
bindings.scope: REL-INS-040 shadow eligibility and compatibility validation only.
